name: lingowp/lingowp
description: Local manual translation and optional AI-assisted translation for WordPress.

scripts.security: sh -c 'rc=0; for t in phpcs deps secrets semgrep semgrep-selftest; do echo "--- $t ---"; composer run --no-interaction security:$t || rc=1; done; exit $rc'
scripts.security:secrets: docker run --rm --mount type=bind,src=.,dst=/repo,ro zricethezav/gitleaks:latest dir /repo --no-banner --redact --report-format=json --report-path=- > security-reports/gitleaks.json
scripts.security:semgrep: docker run --rm --mount type=bind,src=.,dst=/src -w /src semgrep/semgrep semgrep scan --config=p/php --config=p/security-audit --config=.semgrep.yml --error --metrics=off --json-output=security-reports/semgrep.json --exclude=tests/fixtures --text-output=security-reports/semgrep.log
scripts.security:semgrep-selftest: docker run --rm --mount type=bind,src=.,dst=/src,ro -w /src semgrep/semgrep semgrep scan --config=.semgrep.yml --metrics=off --no-git-ignore --json tests/fixtures/ | python3 -c "import json,sys; n=len(json.load(sys.stdin)['results']); print('fixture findings:', n, '(expected 2)'); sys.exit(0 if n==2 else 1)"

scripts-descriptions.test: Pure checks — no WordPress, no database. Safe anywhere.
scripts-descriptions.test:db: Integration checks against the local dev DB, via ./wp (runs inside the Docker wordpress container) — works from any shell, WSL included.
scripts-descriptions.security: All static security scanners. Runs every one, exits non-zero if any failed. Excludes secrets-history (slow, git history) — CI runs that on the weekly schedule instead.
scripts-descriptions.security:phpcs: WPCS security sniffs (escaping, nonces, sanitizing, prepared SQL).
scripts-descriptions.security:secrets: Gitleaks over the working tree. Needs Docker.
scripts-descriptions.security:semgrep: Semgrep PHP + security-audit rules, plus .semgrep.yml (custom wpdb SQL rule). Needs Docker.
scripts-descriptions.security:semgrep-selftest: Asserts the custom wpdb rule still catches exactly the 2 bad cases in tests/fixtures/.
scripts-descriptions.security:secrets-history: Gitleaks over full Git history. Slow — run before a release.
scripts-descriptions.security:plugin-check: WordPress Plugin Check. Needs a running site and wp-cli on PATH.
scripts-descriptions.compat:php: Cross-version PHP syntax check (phpcs-compat.xml.dist, testVersion=7.4-). Guards the composer.json php floor against regressions.
